overview_description.description:
Seater is a mobile-app based transportation service, that offers premium mass transportation services through our mobile application, to bring Parents unique school transportation services, wrapped into an intuitive user experience that is really difficult not to fall in love with.

The existent problems in mass school transportation in most of the world are evident, and needless to say, well agreed upon. 

Lack of reliability, safety procedures, consistency, and supervision, you name it. We are talking about an essential part of the daily lives of people, and something that directly affects them on a daily basis, for all of their lives. Millions and millions of people depend on schools to get around.

Seaters services extend beyond just B2C School transportation, and Corporates. It also provides SaaS solution for schools to organize their operations.

product.name: School / Work Bus
product.description: A transportation service that organizes and optimizes daily commutes for employees and students using AI and technology to create cost-effective routes.

product.name: Tracking Services
product.description: A live tracking and communication system that monitors rides, trip histories, geo-history, speed, and status of pickups for daily, private, or one-time transportation requests.

product.name: Fleet Supply to Institutions
product.description: A service that supplies and manages transportation fleets for companies and schools based on demand, supported by a smart management system.

product.name: Special Requests
product.description: A transportation service handling specific requests from businesses or individuals for one or multiple vehicles, accommodating varied transportation needs.
